title: Cuando cambia el orden
goal: Read a closing synthesis of what jointly precedes a genuine revolution -- land concentration, organized labor, a weakened state, and coordinated opposition -- as the unit sets up the Mexican Revolution.

items: Name the two conditions almost always present before real social change.
Explain whether either condition alone is enough to produce a revolution.
State what distinguishes a country where revolution breaks out from one where discontent merely persists.
Explain how a state can contain discontent for generations, and what makes it vulnerable.
Use tanto... como to present two factors as jointly essential.
